nyczips

Superseded. Use the nycmaps package instead. The two objects this package used to provide are in nycmaps, with the same contents:

  • nycmaps::nyc_zips: New York City ZIP codes by borough, county, and post office.
  • nycmaps::nyc_zip_sf: ZIP code tabulation area polygons with 2019 ACS population, in EPSG:2263 (the copy formerly here was in EPSG:4269).

They were removed from nyczips in version 0.0.1.9001 so that loading both packages no longer masks one copy with the other.

library(nycmaps)

nyc_zip_sf
